dependencies_and_scope.runtime: Python standard library plus the checked-out experimental/branching_context/src package; no install/build step
dependencies_and_scope.fixture: Temporary canonical Store, synthetic checkpoint payloads, fake Coordinator/Backend. Fake native methods enforce the owning worker thread.
dependencies_and_scope.import_staging: CPU-tested importer copies only the selected canonical root snapshot/history/controller and checkpoint envelope/payload into a fresh independent staged Store; validates identities, profile, manifests, payload hashes, and byte/mode immutability before publishing target. It does not load a model or replay prefixes.
dependencies_and_scope.runner_scope: One arm per invocation (resident or disk), three warmups plus nine serial 128-token-reference return samples, exact per-key pool/disk tier witnesses, producer and consumer timelines kept separate, and stage timings. All native runner behavior remains UNRUN.

red_green_history.red: After consolidating submission handling, fake arm test failed with NameError for stale measured-loop handle reference.
red_green_history.green: Removed the stale access and used receipt captured by wait_request; both arm control paths passed.

red_green_history.red: An asynchronous shared-preload fixture initially retained an already-completed future after explicit pool removal, producing no new disk-preload trace and correctly failing tier classification.
red_green_history.green: Updated fake pool preload lifecycle to create a fresh future after completed-load removal while sharing one in-flight future between two callers. Test now verifies shared identity, distinct waiter timing records, and matching exact-key start/success trace.

red_green_history.review_fix_green: Removed main-thread backend counter RPCs; work deltas are read from worker-produced answers. Quiescence precedes pool/cache inspection and removal. Added owner-thread assertions and reversed-order/cross-process tier negatives.
